title: NuanceDatasetEntry
description: Standardized schema for Nuance regional language and threat intelligence entries.

entry_id.description: Unique identifier for cataloging and tracking (e.g., NUANCE-NG-2026-001).

date_collected.description: The ISO 8601 date when the entry was collected (YYYY-MM-DD).

language_dialect.description: Primary dialect, blend, or language mix (e.g., Pidgin-English Blend).

context_tag.description: Categorization tag detailing the specific context or threat vector.

raw_data_text.description: The unedited text script or communication excerpt.

key_slang_words_used.description: List of specific regional slang terms, keywords, or triggers flagged within the text.

integrity_verification.description: Verification status and public origin source.
